Name: Duo Valley
Author: Pearsan0
Description:
[size=5][b]DuoValley - a second screen for Stardew Valley[/b][/size]

DuoValley turns a second display into a full, touch-friendly game menu, drawn with the game's own textures and fonts. It was made for the [b]AYN Thor's bottom screen[/b] (Cinderbox on Android), and it also works on [b]PC with a second monitor[/b], where the picture is identical and you use the mouse.

The menu looks like the game's own menu: five tabs (Inventory, Skills, Social, Map, Crafting) in a frame, always on screen while you play on the main screen. Everything is laid out on a fixed 1240x1080 canvas, so the Thor and the PC show the same thing.


[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]


[b]AYN Thor / Cinderbox (Android)[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Use Cinderbox with SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install the Android zip from Cinderbox's Mods tab (install from zip), or extract it into Mods/DuoValley.[/*]
[*]Start the game. The menu appears on the Thor's bottom screen once the title screen is shown.[/*]
[/list]On Android the bottom screen closes when the game leaves the screen and comes back with it.


[size=5][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Inventory[/b] - your backpack, equipment, portrait, trash can, organize and bundles buttons, and the calendar / billboard button. Touch controls: tap an item to select it (red square and tooltip, a hotbar slot also becomes your tool), drag it to move it, drop it on the trash can to bin it.[/*]
[*][b]Skills[/b] - levels, professions, money, Community Center progress, house level, mine depth, stardrops and mastery.[/*]
[*][b]Social[/b] - every villager in a scrolling list with hearts, gifts and talked-today icons. Swipe or use the scroll bar (snapping or free scrolling, your choice). Tap a villager to open their profile on the main screen.[/*]
[*][b]Map[/b] - the world map as a region at a time, with a row of region buttons, zoom and pan (buttons, mouse wheel, or a two-finger pinch), the mini portraits of players, and villagers if NPC Map Locations is installed.[/*]
[*][b]Crafting[/b] - your known recipes as a scrolling grid. Tap one to select it and read its ingredients and description, then press Craft. If you can make more than one, a slider sets the amount. Hold the button to keep crafting. What you make goes straight to your backpack, and "Inventory full" is shown when there's no room.[/*]
[*][b]Works with the main screen busy[/b] - the Map, Crafting and Social tabs stay usable while a menu or dialogue is open on the main screen.[/*]
[*][b]Title screen scenery[/b] - the second screen shows the title ground, the logo, birds and clouds, and the game's loading screen.[/*]
[*][b]UI Info Suite 2 icons (optional)[/b] - if UI Info Suite 2 is installed, the icons it shows (luck, tomorrow's rain, traveling merchant, birthdays, the cooking show, Robin's building site, the tool at Clint's) appear in a row under the calendar, with that mod's own tooltips, also for the calendar and billboard.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable[/b] - Generic Mod Config Menu options for tab order, map icon size, showing villagers on the map, the Social list scrolling, the number of recipes per row, the selection frame, and more. config.json has finer layout settings (zoom, alignment and padding of each piece).[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.x.[/*]
[*]Either an AYN Thor (or another dual-screen device) running Cinderbox, or a PC with two monitors.[/*]
[*]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for the in-game options.[/*]
[*]Optional: UI Info Suite 2 for the icons under the calendar.[/*]
[*]Optional: NPC Map Locations to show villagers on the Map tab.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Please note:[/b] the Android version relies on Cinderbox's internals, and it is still new. If something doesn't work, post your SMAPI log (filter for "DuoValley") in the comments and I'll look into it.


[size=5][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley, whose art and menus this mod is built from.[/*]
[*]The SMAPI team (Pathoschild and contributors).[/*]
[*]spacechase0 for Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Annosz for UI Info Suite 2, and Bouhm for NPC Map Locations, which this mod can read from.[/*]
[*]The Cinderbox developers for making Stardew playable on the AYN Thor.[/*]
[/list]
